### 💬 About Me

Over the past 9+ years, I've worked across the entire software development lifecycle. I enjoy taking an idea from a blank screen all the way to a live, polished product that people actually use.

Here's how I approach building software:

- **End-to-End Ownership**: I work comfortably across the entire stack. From writing core backend business logic in Java and tuning PostgreSQL database queries, to crafting responsive frontend components in Angular and packaging apps for iOS and Android, I love connecting all the pieces.
- **Mobile & Web Together**: I build mobile-first web applications and bring them to native iOS and Android using Capacitor. This gives users a smooth mobile experience with native device capabilities while keeping a single, clean codebase.
- **Reliable & Clean Code**: I believe good software should just work. I focus on clean architecture, strong typing, automated tests, and handling real-world edge cases (especially around financial transactions, ledgers, and user privacy).
- **Smooth DevOps**: Getting code to production shouldn't be stressful. I set up Docker containers, manage Linux servers, and automate builds and tests with GitHub Actions so updates ship safely and reliably.
- **Practical AI & Modern Tools**: I use modern AI tools to make building software faster and smarter — from creating custom MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers and vector search pipelines to automating everyday developer workflows.
- **Giving Back to Open Source**: Open-source tools have helped me throughout my career, so I actively contribute back with bug fixes, new features, and community architecture guides.

### 🚀 What I'm Building

- 💰 **[Poolcount](https://poolcount.com)** — *Founder & Lead Architect* • [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/imdurgeshpal/poolcount)  
  A modern, mobile-first web and mobile app for group money collection and expense tracking.
  - **Backend**: Built with Java 25 & Spring Boot 4, PostgreSQL, secure authentication, and exact integer minor-unit financial ledger calculations.
  - **Frontend & Mobile**: Built with Angular 22 (Signals & Standalone), responsive UI, packaged for Web, iOS, and Android via Capacitor.
  - **DevOps & Cloud**: Automated CI/CD with GitHub Actions, Docker, Render, and Cloudflare edge networking.

- 🏢 **[Pal Labs](https://pallabs.com)** — *Product Studio* • [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/imdurgeshpal/pallabs)  
  Parent studio and publishing home for my independent web and mobile software projects.
